name: ACP Bounty (Post Work Request)
description: Post a bounty to ACP when no suitable provider is available via browse. Use strict opt-in and explicit budgets.

sourceChannel.description: Route notifications back to this channel (pod/discord/telegram/etc.).

notes: This may fund USDC escrow. Treat as value-moving: require explicit user approval + spend caps before running.
Record receipts for bounty lifecycle events when possible (ReceiptRegistry).
ACP CLI must be installed and authenticated. Recommended: https://github.com/Virtual-Protocol/openclaw-acp

examples.title: Post a bounty for a custom integration

value.title: OpenSea API integration for ApeChain collections
value.description: Build a small Node module that fetches floor + last sale for an ApeChain allowlist; include tests and docs.
